scripts.web:build: tsc -b && vite build --mode web && node scripts/validate-runtime-bundle.mjs web
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/validate-runtime-bundle.mjs terminal233
scripts.test: npm run test:ui && npm run test:server
scripts.terminal233:dev: npm run build && cargo run --manifest-path terminal233/Cargo.toml
scripts.terminal233:package:windows: npm run build && npm run terminal233:build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-terminal233-windows.ps1
scripts.terminal233:package:windows:arm64: npm run build && rustup target add aarch64-pc-windows-msvc && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-terminal233-windows.ps1 -Target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-terminal233-windows.ps1 -Target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.verify:web-launcher: cargo fmt --manifest-path web-launcher/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path web-launcher/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path web-launcher/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.audit:rust: cargo audit --file terminal233/Cargo.lock && cargo audit --file web-launcher/Cargo.lock
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run web:build && npm test && npm run server:go:test && npm run test:pure-rust-ssh && cargo fmt --manifest-path terminal233/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path terminal233/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path terminal233/Cargo.toml --locked --all-features && npm run test:native-ssh && npm run verify:web-launcher
